settingsSub: How this computer's desk looks, syncs, prints and keeps its backups.
themeSystemHint: Follows the light or dark setting in Windows.
pillFailed: {count, plural, one {# change refused} other {# changes refused}}
stripFailed: {count, plural, one {The dashboard refused a change made here.} other {The dashboard refused # changes made here.}}
stripPending: {count, plural, one {One change is on its way to the dashboard.} other {# changes are on their way to the dashboard.}}
stripPendingOffline: {count, plural, one {No connection — one change is saved on this computer and uploads by itself when the line is back.} other {No connection — # changes are saved on this computer and upload by themselves when the line is back.}}
firstAccountTitle: This desk has no account yet
firstAccountBody: The desk signs in to the dashboard as the maintenance account, so every ticket and change made here appears on the site under that name. Enter its email and password in Settings → Account.
firstErrorTitle: The board could not be read
firstOfflineBody: This computer has never downloaded the tickets. Connect it once and they come down; after that the desk works with or without the internet.
firstDownloadBody: The first download brings every ticket onto this computer. It happens once — after this the desk opens instantly, online or not.
redownloadBody: This computer's copy of the tickets is thrown away and downloaded fresh from the dashboard. Nothing on the dashboard changes.
redownloadBodyPending: {count, plural, one {This computer's copy of the tickets is downloaded fresh from the dashboard. The one change still waiting here is kept and sent first.} other {This computer's copy of the tickets is downloaded fresh from the dashboard. The # changes still waiting here are kept and sent first.}}
outboxEmpty: Everything made on this computer is on the dashboard.
outboxPendingOffline: Saved here until the line is back ({count})
discardCreateBody: Ticket {code} was opened on this computer and never reached the dashboard. Discarding it removes the ticket from this computer for good.
discardBody: The change to {code} is dropped from this computer, and the ticket goes back to what the dashboard holds.
photoWhy_unsupported: this kind of picture cannot be read here; save it as JPEG or PNG first
photoWhy_unreadable: the file is damaged or is not a picture
photoWhy_upload_failed: it could not be saved on this computer
languageHint: The desk's words and its direction. The dashboard's own copy follows the same choice.
benchHint: The repair desk and the programming desk keep separate tickets. A computer works one of them.
benchHardwareHint: Screens, batteries, boards — the repair bench.
benchSoftwareHint: System installs, unlocks, accounts and data transfer.
benchOnlyOne: The maintenance account may work only this desk. Another is offered once the account is given it on the dashboard.
closeToTray: Closing keeps it running in the tray
closeToTrayHint: In the tray the desk keeps syncing and keeps announcing new tickets. Quit from the tray icon's menu.
textSizeHint: The whole window, words and controls together. Ctrl and + or − change it from anywhere.
reduceMotionHint: Dialogs and lists appear at once instead of sliding in.
notifyWhatHint: Shown in the bell, and as a Windows notification when the desk is not in front of you.
notifyConnection: The internet going and coming back
notifySoundHint: A soft chime for news, a lower one for a problem.
printersHint: Which printer takes the receipt and which takes the label — kept on this computer, exactly as on the dashboard.
agentHint: The small program that sends papers to the printers without a dialog. The desk starts it itself.
agentRestartHint: If a printer was plugged in after the agent started and is not listed, restart the agent.
agentAutoStart: Start the agent with the desk
syncInterval: How often to check the dashboard
syncIntervalHint: While online. A change made here is sent at once whatever this says.
siteUrlHint: Where photos are uploaded and where links from the desk open.
siteUrlInvalid: An address starting with https://, with nothing after the domain.
backupsHint: A copy of everything on this computer — the tickets and the changes still waiting to upload.
keepCopies: {count, plural, one {The last copy} other {The last # copies}}
backupOnQuit: Back up when the app closes
backupMirrorHint: Every backup is also copied here — a USB stick or a shared folder — so a dead disk does not take the backups with it.
backupError_backup_invalid: the file is not a backup of this desk
accountHint: The desk has no sign-in of its own. It works as this dashboard account, so everything done here appears on the site under its name.
accountWhy: Every ticket opened here is filed under this account, and every change carries its name on the dashboard's history. The password is kept on this computer encrypted by Windows.
accountPasswordKept: A password is saved. Type a new one only to change it.
accountConfirmBody: The desk signs in with these details first and keeps them only if the dashboard accepts them.
accountSaved: Signed in — the desk now works as this account.
accountError_invalid_credentials: The dashboard did not accept that email and password.
accountError_offline: No connection — the details can only be checked online.
